policy: ARTDACI keeps its reviewed pedagogical layer as the presentation authority. External providers enrich identifiers, labels, descriptions, hierarchy and provenance; they do not silently overwrite ARTDACI editorial content.

sources.name: ARTDACI editorial
sources.notes: Reviewed trilingual pedagogical labels, definitions and semantic assertions.

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.notes: Used for persistent Q identifiers, multilingual labels/descriptions and cross-dataset identifiers.

sources.name: Getty Art & Architecture Thesaurus (AAT)
sources.attribution: Contains information from the J. Paul Getty Trust, Getty Research Institute, the Art & Architecture Thesaurus, which is made available under the ODC Attribution License.
sources.notes: Used for authoritative art/architecture concept identifiers and thesaurus alignment. Getty XML web services are discontinued; ARTDACI uses LOD/SPARQL.

sources.name: Memodata / The Integral Dictionary
sources.notes: Sensagent pages still advertise XML/content services powered by Memodata, but no sufficiently clear current public API/reuse license was verified on 2026-10-04. No automated ingestion is enabled until access and reuse terms are confirmed.

sources.name: Getty Union List of Artist Names (ULAN)
sources.notes: Used for authoritative identifiers and linked-data enrichment for artists, museums, repositories and other people/corporate bodies.
sources.attribution: Contains information from the J. Paul Getty Trust, Getty Research Institute, Getty Vocabulary Program, made available under the ODC Attribution License.

sources.name: Getty Thesaurus of Geographic Names (TGN)
sources.notes: Used for authoritative identifiers and linked-data enrichment for places associated with artworks, artists and museums.
sources.attribution: Contains information from the J. Paul Getty Trust, Getty Research Institute, Getty Vocabulary Program, made available under the ODC Attribution License.

sources.name: Iconclass
sources.attribution: Iconclass notation and linked record; live linking only. No bulk reuse is assumed because the current public Terms page does not state a reusable data license.
sources.notes: Used for iconographic subjects and depicted content. ARTDACI stores only selected notation mappings and retrieves linked records on demand.
